messages:
sara: Quick sync — I sketched a decision canvas for the geo-slicing sprint, want to lock scope before we push to planning.
mike: pinged the infra leads, can we surface estimated infra cost per slice? that's the big unknown.
jia: putting rough numbers together — cross-region egress and extra KV hops drive most of it. I can model 3 scenarios.
sara: thanks. Canvas aims to prioritize by customer risk, SLO, and cost delta. Key question: do we treat policy DSL as part of MVP or boot it to follow-up?
henry: my take — include minimal DSL (affinity + hard region constraint) in MVP. Advanced steering (latency/cost-weighted) can be 2nd wave.
anika: customer ask from FinReg: strict data-residency gating + audit trail. That pushes region constraints into MVP for those customers.
mike: infra note — MVP per-region control needs tagging + quota accounting. If we do per-tenant slices, we'll need 2 extra control-plane tables (estimated ~8GB index) and a per-request lookup hit.
sara: tradeoffs: ship early with simple hard gates vs wait for routing fallback policy. Decision effect on migration time: simple gates = faster migration for prioritized customers.
jia: cost model snippets:
```
scenario A: soft-affinity (prob route-optimize) => +12% egress
scenario B: hard-isolate (pin region) => +27% infra overhead
scenario C: hybrid (cache + pinning) => +15% infra, -8% tail latency
```
henry: acceptance criteria proposal (short):
```
- canary rollout (1% traffic) with auto-rollback
- regional p95 latency within 20% of baseline
- no tenant cross-region reads for "residency" flag
- audit events emitted for routing decisions
```
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging: rb-geo-slice/feature-branch @ 1761234578
anika: for FinReg we need exportable audit logs and KMS-backed key ids in scope. add to non-functional requirements.
sara: next steps: (1) Jia to finalize cost scenarios by Friday, (2) Mike to validate control-plane storage estimate, (3) Henry to draft minimal DSL syntax, (4) PMs to run customer impact matrix.
mike: I'll slot infra estimate by EOD Thursday.
jia: will post model + spreadsheet link when done.
sara: good — I'll take this to roadmap sync Tuesday. If we agree, MVP = hard-region + affinity flag + audit logs. Anything major I'm missing?"
